She can live with sensible secondary school-aged children and would enjoy an active family who can provide plenty of enrichment, adventures and companionship. Skye is also looking for owners who can gradually build up her time left alone, helping her settle confidently into the home.

Affectionate, intelligent and full of character, Skye is ready to find a family to share her next adventure with.

name: Cadie
description:
Meet lovely Cadie — a sweet, spirited girl with a real zest for life. She adores her walks and enjoys exploring the grass and hedgerows, taking in all the exciting scents along the way. Cadie’s favourite thing is meeting people, and she absolutely loves a fuss and a cuddle.

Cadie does have a strong chase instinct and may chase wildlife, so she will need sensible management when out and about, especially in the countryside. She is looking for an owner who can continue the training she has already started and help her build on her progress.

Cadie has a history of urinary tract infections, so she may experience flare-ups in the future. At the moment, this is being managed by keeping her at a healthy weight and ensuring she stays active and mobile with a low dose of medications which she will need to continue on with.

This affectionate girl loves playing with toys and is happy around older children. She loves to meet and greet other dogs out on her walk but she would prefer to be the only dog in her new home. If you think Cadie could be the perfect addition to your family, she would love to meet you.

name: George
description:
George is a lovely, gentle boy who enjoys the simple things in life: exploring on walks, sniffing his surroundings and spending time with his favourite people. He travels well and is housetrained, making him an easy companion to have around the home.

Although George may take a little while to get to know new people, but once he does he soon relaxes and happily accepts fuss and treats. He can be a little boisterous initially and would benefit from calm companionship. A true foodie, George already knows cues such as sit and paw and will be delighted to show off his skills for a tasty reward.

George has lived with children previously and could share his home with calm, older children who can give him time and space to settle into his new routine. He is happy being left for periods of time once settled.

He has seasonal skin issues and has flare ups from time to time which can be managed well with medicated shampoo baths and if need be anti-inflammatories from the vets and regular gland emptying. He is currently fed on hypoallergenic food due to his skin sensitivities.

name: Ronnie
description:
Ronnie is a lovely ex racing greyhound with a real zest for life and adventure. He enjoys leaning into you for fuss and is happiest when he can relax with a tasty chewy!

Ronnie is looking for a home where he can be the only dog. Due to his desire to chase he would not be able to live with cats or other small animals.

He could live with teenage children who can respect his space and allow him the time to settle.

Ronnie will need some ongoing house training in his new home and will need access to a secure, high fenced garden.

If you think you could offer Ronnie his new home then we look forward to hearing from you.

name: Roxy
description:
Roxy is a sweet, cuddly girl who needs a calm environment where she can flourish and grow. Her new family will need to advocate for her, guide her through new situations, and provide slow, steady, and positive exposure to the world at her own pace.

Roxy finds busy environments stressful, a quiet, slow and steady area would best suit her. On her walks, she can be quite enthusiastic and will need plenty of mental stimulation to keep her clever mind active.

Having spent so much time raising her puppies, Roxy is adjusting well to being on her own but can still let out a little whine when left behind. Her new owners will need to build up her alone time slowly and softly.

name: Snoopy
description:
She is a sweet, gentle and affectionate dog and once she's built a bond with you, her personality really starts to shine!

She loves a fuss, has the cutest way of sleeping (always in the funniest positions!), and when it's playtime, she can't resist a good zoom around with her toys.

Snoopy is looking for an understanding owner that can continue to support her around other dogs. She can be vocal when she sees them, so she enjoys on-lead walks in quieter areas where she can relax and enjoy all the sniffs. She has made amazing progress with her training while in our care, and we will make sure a new owner knows everything we have been doing to help set her up for success.

Snoopy has so much love to give and is ready to find someone who will love her just as much in return.

name: Betty
description:
Betty is a true Beagle through and through! She adores attention, enjoys being around people, loves her walks, and will never say no to a tasty treat.

This lovely girl is full of energy and loves to explore the world with her nose. Every walk is an adventure, with plenty of exciting scents to investigate along the way! Betty would really enjoy some off-lead time in a secure, enclosed area where she can safely sniff and explore to her heart's content. As she can be quite strong on the lead at times, she'll need an owner who is physically confident and able to manage her on walks.

A secure garden is a must for Betty, giving her a safe space to play, stretch her legs, and enjoy spending time outdoors.

Betty does find it difficult being left alone, so she's looking for a home where someone is around for much of the day. Having company will help her settle into her new home and make the transition as smooth as possible.

She's a very clever girl, especially when treats are involved! Betty is eager to learn and would thrive with positive, reward-based training that keeps her mind busy as well as her nose.

If you're looking for a fun-loving, affectionate companion who will fill your home with love, laughter, and plenty of Beagle charm, Betty could be the perfect match.

name: Sam
description:
Sam is a wonderful little chap on the lookout for his forever home, he is looking for a home that is able to help support Sam with building up being left alone, so there will need to be multiple people in his new home to keep him company whilst he settles and help him to learn how to be home alone .

Sam is a super social boy and has made many friends here at the centre both human and Canine, and could share his home with a doggy friend who is looking for a playful buddy to enjoy a good play bow and zoom around the garden.

Sam could share his home with older primary school age children who are confident around bouncy dogs and don't mind being smothered in love and cuddles.

If Sam sounds like the dog you’ve been searching for, please get in touch today!

name: Bueno
description:
Our bubbly Bueno is looking for her new home! This girl is full of character and has a zest for life. She would make a lovely addition to a family home.

Bueno could live with Teenage children in her new home, that can give her time to settle but also be involved in her day to day care.

Bueno also has the potential to live with another dog in the home, pending meets at the centre. The resident dog would need to of lived with a dog before.

Flat faced (brachycephalic) dogs suffer from additional health problems, which may impact their quality of life. We always recommend anyone thinking about adopting or buying a flat faced (brachycephalic) dog to thoroughly research the breed beforehand. Our expert team will be able to give you tips on exercise and weight management and advice on any support Bueno may need going forward.

name: Biscoff
description:
Our beautiful Biscoff is looking for his new home! This boy is full of love and has a zest for life. He would make a lovely addition to a family home.

Biscoff could live with primary aged children in his new home, that can give him time to settle but also be involved in his day to day care.

Biscoff also has the potential to live with another dog in the home, pending meets at the centre. The resident dog would need to of lived with a dog before. However, he would be unable to live with cats or small animals.

Flat faced (brachycephalic) dogs suffer from additional health problems, which may impact their quality of life. We always recommend anyone thinking about adopting or buying a flat faced (brachycephalic) dog to thoroughly research the breed beforehand. Our expert team will be able to give you tips on exercise and weight management and advice on any support Biscoff may need going forward.

name: Jimmy
description:
Meet Jimmy, a handsome black and white Greyhound with a gentle nature and a playful streak. He enjoys leisurely walks, exploring his surroundings, and having a zoom around a secure paddock, especially if there's a squeaky toy or football involved!

Jimmy is a friendly and easy-going lad who enjoys saying hello but isn't overly demanding of attention. He can be a little bouncy when greeting people, which is his charming way of showing his excitement to make new friends. Once he's said hello, he's happy to relax and do his own thing. As he settles into a home environment, we're sure his personality will continue to blossom.

As a large dog, Jimmy would love a home with space to stretch out comfortably, a cosy bed for his afternoon snoozes, and a medium to large car for travelling. Access to a secure garden or safe enclosed areas where he can enjoy a run would also be ideal. Jimmy has a friendly, gentle nature, and we feel he could live with children who are able to respect his space and allow him time to settle into his new routine.

Jimmy gets on well with other dogs and could live with a suitable canine companion following successful introductions. He is looking for patient adopters who can help him adapt to family life, as many aspects of home living will be new experiences for him.

As Jimmy hasn't lived in a home environment before, he will need some support with toilet training and learning the routines of everyday life. With a little patience and guidance, we think he'll make a wonderful companion.

If you're looking for a laid-back, lovable dog with a fun side and plenty of potential, Jimmy could be the perfect match for you!

name: Ray
description:
"Baby where on earth is my Family, what has taken you so long to find MeHeeHee",.

Introducing the handsome Ray, who is full of beans and the joys of life and would love to find a Family to share that joy with!

Ray loves his favourite people and making new friends, he can be quite excitable and does jump up so owners who can help him keep his paws on the floor would be great. he walks nicely on a loose lead .  As with most greyhounds he does need a secure space to burn of some energy as well as his on lead walks.

He is able to live with children of school age who are confident with dogs and could share his home with a likeminded dog but unfortunately no cats or small pets as Ray will find these far too interesting.  Ray may also need support settling into a home as he may not have spent much time in one and will need a refresher on housetraining as he is not always clean in his kennel.

If you are looking for a happy go lucky young man and enjoy a good snuggle on the sofa with your canine friend then Ray could tick all the boxes for you.

name: Shy
description:
Shy by name, but definitely not Shy by nature!

People are her absolute favourite thing in this whole wide world; old or young, new or familiar - everyone is a friend to Shy!

Whilst she lives for cuddles, and will squeeze herself onto your knee, Shy is also up for any adventure. She loves to go on holiday in the campervan, she finds the car really fun, and watching the world is her favourite past time!

Agreeing to take on Shy means also indulging her spa days. She certainly knows how to relax. A lovely bath followed by an invigorating towel dry. Don't worry, Shy doesn't expect you to be a professional, as long as you know how to use the massage gun, she'll be quite happy!

When it's time for bed Shy deserves the best, and the best is probably your bed. But don't worry, she's so small you'll barely notice her there.

It's not all about Shy though, and she gives love and much as she receives it. She is very gentle around children and could live in a home with kids of any age. She just likes to be close by, and if they happen to offer her a stroke, she'll be happy to lean in.

Shy also has dog friends, so she could live in a home with another dog. She's also gentle with other animals, not showing any interest in chasing, so she could live with a cat as well.

Shy is just waiting to slot into a new family. If she sounds like the girl for you, please apply!

Flat faced (brachycephalic) dogs suffer from additional health problems, which may impact their quality of life. We always recommend anyone thinking about adopting or buying a flat faced (brachycephalic) dog to thoroughly research the breed beforehand. Our expert team will be able to give you tips on exercise and weight management and advice on any support [insert name] may need.

name: Poppy & Scooby
description:
Poppy and Scooby are a wonderful bonded pair searching for a patient and understanding home together. Poppy, the whiter of the two, is the more confident companion and helps her best friend Scooby navigate the world. Scooby, with his darker face and floppy ears, takes great comfort from Poppy's presence and relies heavily on her guidance, so they are looking for a home where they can remain side by side.

Both dogs can be a little wary of unfamiliar situations and have lived quite a sheltered life, meaning they have had limited experience of busy households and bustling environments. Because of this, they will need adopters who can give them plenty of time to settle in, build confidence, and adjust to their new surroundings at their own pace.

When out and about, Poppy and Scooby would thrive with access to quieter walking routes where there is a smaller opportunity of bigger crowds and no chance of encountering off lead dogs. Scooby in particular can become worried by unfamiliar people on walks and would benefit from owners who understand his need for space and can advocate for him by creating distance when needed. With patient handling and predictable routines, he is able to feel much more relaxed and comfortable.

Once they know and trust you, both dogs are incredibly affectionate and loving companions who enjoy human company and spending time with their favourite people. Watching their bond with each other and with those they trust is truly rewarding.

Poppy and Scooby are looking for a calm, adult home with no younger children and no other dogs or cats, allowing them the space and security they need to flourish. They could live with one or two older teenagers in the home following appropriate introductions. In return, they will offer loyalty, companionship, and plenty of affection to a family willing to give them the fresh start they deserve.

•	Must be rehomed together

•	Quiet, predictable household

•	No younger children

•	Access to quiet walking areas

•	Owners willing to provide space and understanding for Scooby around unfamiliar people

•	Patient adopters who can help them settle and build confidence at their own pace

name: Peter
description:
Looking for a gentle giant with a heart full of love and a personality that will make you smile every day? Then let us introduce the wonderful Peter!

This handsome lad is all about affection. Whether you're a familiar friend or someone he's just met, Peter will happily wander over for a fuss, lean gently into you, and soak up every bit of attention. Give him a good bum scratch and you'll be rewarded with his adorable little happy stomps that never fail to make people laugh.

Peter takes comfort from his beloved soft toys and enjoys having them close by when it's time to relax. He also has one true foodie love: chicken! Chicken treats, chicken feet, or pretty much anything chicken flavoured, and you'll instantly become his favourite person.

A laid-back and easy-going boy, Peter enjoys shorter walks where he can take his time exploring and sniffing the world around him. When outdoors, he's much more interested in taking in his surroundings than snacking, but indoors he's always happy to tuck into a tasty treat. Peter loves being close to his handlers and enjoys spending quality time with his favourite people. When the day is done, this lazy lad is more than happy to settle down for a snooze, content just being nearby. He has a wonderfully calm nature and isn't demanding, making him a lovely companion to have around the home.

Peter wouldn't be suited to share his home with children and could potentially live with another dog who matches his gentle, easy going personality. If you're searching for a loyal best friend who gives endless love, and the sweetest little stomps, Peter could be the perfect match.

name: Acorn
description:
Meet Little Miss Acorn!

She is shy meeting new people and will need a few meets to get to know you and to build a bond with you. She could potentially live with school aged children who would help build her confidence and settle her into the home.

When she knows you Acorn is a sweet lovable girl who enjoys having cuddles with her friends.

She loves her toys and her favourite thing to do is grab a toy in our off-lead paddocks and zoom around, flinging her toy up and about to catch!

Acorn could share her new home with a confident, well-mannered dog, dependant on meets here at the centre. She has a prey drive so couldn't live in a home with cats or other small animals.

We think Acorn, once she has built her confidence she would make a lovely addition to someone's home, if you think she could be the missing piece in yours please apply!

name: Tiggy Wiggy
description:
Tiggy Wiggy is a young, fun-loving girl with a zest for life and a heart full of affection. Bursting with energy and enthusiasm, she loves getting out and about for adventures before curling up for a well earned snooze!

Tiggy loves to have a paddle in the stream and have off lead time in a secure run. She enjoys playing with her toys and getting a tasty chewy to settle down with.

Tiggy could live with teenage children who have been used to living with bouncy dogs before. She could potentially live with another large dog in her new home, that has lived with dogs before.

Tiggy wouldn't be able to live with cats or small animals due to her desire to chase!

If you have room in your life for a girl who Is full of character, then Tiggy Wiggy could be the perfect addition to your home.

name: Mojo
description:
Miss Mojo is a vibrant, joyful girl with an infectious zest for life that shines through in everything she does. She thrives in an active home where her energy and enthusiasm can truly blossom, so if you love walks, outdoor adventures, and fun games, she may be your perfect match. Mojo is a clever, eager learner who is always ready to try something new, especially when tasty treats are involved.

While in our care, she has enjoyed making dog friends and walking alongside them, and she could happily share her home with another dog who matches her playful temperament. She could also live with a family, either with or without older children, however she will not be able to live with cats. Mojo may need a little support when learning to be left alone in a new home, but with patience and guidance, she will flourish into a loyal and loving companion. A home with a secure garden and high fencing would support Mojo with her off lead time as she will need to be exercised in public on lead.

Full of personality, she brings laughter, affection, and a touch of cheeky charm wherever she goes. She will suit adopters who are ready to invest time in her continued training, for example her lead walking - she can be quite strong sometimes so this is something an adopter needs to consider. With the right home, Miss Mojo will be a devoted best friend and an exciting partner for all of life’s adventures.

name: Frank
description:
This lovely boy is a retired greyhound, a gentle soul who is looking forward to discovering all the joys life has to bring.

He can be a little unsure at first, so would suit a patient family with children who understand the importance of giving him time and space to settle at his own pace.

As he builds confidence, his true personality shines through, He’s an affectionate boy who adores fuss and will happily soak up all the love you can give.

He could potentially share his home with another calm dog of a similar size, but he isn’t able to live with cats or small pets.

A home with a secure garden would be perfect for him to enjoy the occasional run around, and he loves a spot of solo play, followed by a well-earned snooze in a shady spot.

This sweet boy has so much love to give and is ready to become a cherished companion in his forever home.

name: Timmy
description:
Timmy is a handsome, gentle giant weighing in at almost 35kg, but don't let his size fool you, he truly has a heart of gold.

This steady, easy going boy is a pleasure to walk and enjoys strolling nicely by your side on the lead. Timmy is friendly and welcoming when meeting new people, always happy to say hello. If you're lucky, you may even be treated to the classic Greyhound lean, a sure sign that he's taken a shine to you and is enjoying your company!

Timmy has also been spending time in the office with the team, where he has shown just how well-mannered he can be. He's learned to settle beautifully on his bed and is content to relax while the world goes on around him.

When it comes to his forever home, Timmy isn't asking for much. He's looking for a family who can offer companionship, gentle walks, plenty of affection, and, of course, a very large comfy bed to stretch out on after a busy day of being adorable.

If you're searching for a calm, affectionate companion who will happily be by your side and reward you with endless love, Timmy could be the perfect addition to your family.

name: Bailey
description:
*BAILEY HAS AN APPLICATION IN PROGRESS*

Meet brilliant Bailey, a handsome older boy who is ready to find a calm and loving home to call his own.

Bailey is a friendly and affectionate boy who enjoys spending time with his favourite people. He has settled beautifully into his foster home, where he is the only dog, and is showing just how much he enjoys a quieter routine with space to relax. Once Bailey has made himself at home, he enjoys being close to his people, settling nearby and making the most of life’s simple pleasures.

Bailey may be older, but he still very much enjoys getting out and about. He loves his walks, exploring new places and especially enjoys swimming! He can be a clever, curious little chap and would enjoy owners who can offer him enrichment, gentle training and plenty of positive encouragement.

Bailey is generally neutral around dogs when out and about, but he has previously found living with other dogs difficult. For this reason, he is looking to be the only pet in his new home, where he can enjoy having his own space and one-to-one attention.

Bailey could live with secondary school aged children who understand that he may appreciate a quieter space when things get busy. He would prefer a home that is not too hectic, with owners who can offer him a predictable routine and help him settle at his own pace.

This lovely lad has so much to offer and is thriving now he has found a calmer environment. If Bailey sounds like the companion for you, please apply today.

name: George
description:
George is a handsome, lovable chap who's searching for a patient and understanding home where he can truly thrive. With the right support, reassurance, and guidance, George has all the potential to blossom into the most loyal companion.

Once George gets to know you, you'll have a friend for life. He absolutely adores his people and loves nothing more than staying close by their side. As with many sensitive dogs, he can be a little wary when meeting new people, so he'll appreciate owners who can gently support and guide him through new situations, helping him build his confidence at his own pace.

George is a big fan of his daily walks, especially when they're nice and relaxed. Rather than rushing from A to B, he enjoys taking his time to sniff and explore the world around him - after all, every walk is an adventure when there are so many interesting scents to discover! He's happy to greet other dogs while out and about, but he'd be happiest as the only dog in his new home, where he can enjoy all the love and attention for himself.

If you're looking for a devoted best friend and have the patience, understanding, and enthusiasm to continue George's training, you'll be rewarded with a wonderful companion. By providing him with the reassurance, consistency, and stability he needs, you'll help him grow in confidence and become the happy, secure dog he's meant to be.

Could you be the special person George has been waiting for?

name: Freddie
description:
Meet the wonderful Freddie - he's a handsome lad who is absolutely full of beans! Freddie does have an old cruciate injury to one of his hind legs. This is now healed, but will need ongoing management in his new home, as he can get stiff after lots of exercise and is also on a special diet to support his mobility.

He is a very playful boy and loves nothing more than carrying his toys around or playing fetch with you. Freddie also loves to swim and will sniff out any puddle, river, or lake that he can have a good splash around in!

He does have some ongoing training needs to be worked on in his new home, such as his recall, learning not to jump up at people he meets, and loose lead walking. When he is in a familiar environment, he settles well and has very good manners in the home. However, he can quickly forget himself in new situations and needs some support when things get a bit overwhelming.

He has experience of being around children but would prefer older children who can join him with his games of fetch and be a part of his daily care. He is social greeter with other dogs on his walks and will want to encourage them to play, but is likely to be too excitable for some dogs. He could potentially live with a well-matched dog who will join him in a game and tolerate his bounciness.

If you think Freddie sounds like a good match for you, please apply now!

name: Rolo
description:
Meet Rolo, a charismatic and affectionate young dog who loves nothing more than spending time with his favourite people.

Whether it's enjoying plenty of fuss and cuddles or heading out on an adventure, Rolo is happiest when he's with those he loves. On walks, he's an enthusiastic explorer who likes to take in everything around him, from meeting new people to watching the world go by.

A playful and fun-loving companion, Rolo particularly enjoys a game of tug. He can become quite excited during play and may get a little vocal, but he has already started some positive training around play sessions and would benefit from this being continued in his new home.

Rolo is very interested in other dogs and would love to make new friends while out and about. Due to his strength and enthusiasm, he is still learning how to greet other dogs calmly and appropriately, so he is looking for adopters who are committed to continuing his training in this area. With the right introductions, Rolo could potentially live with a suitable canine companion in the future.

Having previously lived with older children, Rolo has shown himself to be gentle and affectionate around them and would enjoy being part of a family environment. However, he is unable to live with cats.

Full of personality, Rolo is loving, cheeky, and guaranteed to keep you smiling with his goofy antics. Once he's had the chance to play and burn off some energy, he is more than happy to settle down and enjoy some quiet time by your side, making him a wonderful companion. Due to his breed characteristics and training needs, Rolo would benefit from a home with breed experience.

If you're looking for a handsome, affectionate young dog with a big heart and an even bigger personality, Rolo could be the perfect addition to your family. Apply today to find out more about this wonderful boy.

name: Buddy
description:
Looking for a loyal little companion to share your sofa, enjoy gentle strolls and keep you company through life's quieter moments? Then let us introduce you to Buddy.

At nearly 14 years old, Buddy is a charming Jack Russell Terrier who has spent his whole life in a loving family home. He may be a senior gentleman, but he still enjoys getting out and about for a daily sniffy walk and exploring the world at his own pace.

Buddy is a friendly and affectionate dog who enjoys spending time with his people. He can be a little reserved when first meeting someone new, but once he feels comfortable, he'll happily come over for gentle fuss and companionship. He isn't demanding or overly energetic these days – he's much more interested in finding a cosy spot to curl up after an adventure.

One of Buddy's favourite things in life is having the freedom to mooch and sniff. He walks nicely on lead, enjoys off-lead opportunities where safe, and takes everyday sights such as traffic, cyclists and other walkers in his stride.

Buddy is generally sociable with other dogs and has enjoyed spending time with canine friends throughout his life. He particularly appreciates calm and polite dogs and could potentially share his new home with a similarly relaxed older dog following successful introductions.

Having lived in a family home with children, Buddy is well used to family life. As an older dog who enjoys his rest, we feel he would be happiest with sensible older children who can understand when he would like some quiet time.

Buddy is a wonderful example of how special senior dogs can be. His ideal home would be one where he can enjoy a comfortable retirement, plenty of companionship, gentle walks, tasty treats and somewhere warm to snooze. In return, he'll offer his new family loyalty, affection and all the charm that comes with a dog who knows how to enjoy the simple things in life.

If you have room in your heart and home for a lovely old boy who deserves to be cherished, Buddy would love to meet you. ??

name: Poppy
description:
Say hello to Poppy, a sweet middle aged lady who is looking for a new family.

Poppy is a very friendly dog, she enjoys meeting new people, introducing herself and having some fuss.  She is also super playful and loves chase her favourite ball around in the garden or on a walk, she is also partial to carrying a soft toy around with her or throw it in the air.

Poppy has experience of spending time with grandchildren in her family and had a good relationship with them so could live with children again pending meets at the centre.  She is social with other dogs on the whole but will show she is uncomfortable if they are too big and too OTT with her.  So we think she would be best suited as an only pet in her new home.

She will initially need owners who can help her settle and get into a routine with her housetraining and being left on her own, so owners who are around for most of the day would be ideal.

If you are looking for a playful little companion to join your home then Poppy could be the girl for you

name: Charlie
description:
Charlie is a handsome young lad with a zest for life and plenty of energy to share. He's a big, strong boy with a fun-loving personality, so he's looking for confident owners who are comfortable handling a larger dog and can provide him with the guidance he needs to thrive.

Because of his size and enthusiasm, Charlie would be best suited to a home with teenagers and above, where everyone can enjoy his playful nature.

Charlie has previously lived successfully with both cats and other dogs and may be able to do so again following successful introductions. He loves playing with other dogs and enjoys making canine friends.

As a young dog, Charlie is still learning his manners and would benefit from owners who are committed to continuing his training. With consistent and positive guidance, he's sure to make fantastic progress.

Flat faced (brachycephalic) dogs suffer from additional health problems, which may impact their quality of life. We always recommend anyone thinking about adopting or buying a flat faced (brachycephalic) dog to thoroughly research the breed beforehand. Our expert team will be able to give you tips on exercise and weight management and advice on any support Charlie may need going forward.

Charlie is a wonderful all-round companion with so much love to give. If you're looking for an affectionate best friend and can offer Charlie the loving home he deserves, please apply today!

name: Fregs (& Dickie)
description:
Meet Dickie and Fregs, a father and son duo that are searching for their forever home.

Fregs loves humans and will try to kiss any new people he meets! He is very people-oriented, enjoys following his humans around, and gets a lot out of his human relationships.

Dickie is the older, wiser, more stoic of the duo, enjoying affection with his humans whilst also enjoying his own space too. Dickie likes a good nap at his humans’ side, enjoys his food and walks, and has always shared a strong bond with his son Fregs. Dickie inspires confidence in Fregs, and he can be seen imitating Dickie’s behaviour and following in his footsteps. Like any good dad, he leads by example, and like any good son, Fregs looks to Dickie for guidance.

They both enjoy their walks but can get a bit overwhelmed when seeing other dogs out on a walk. Dickie and Fregs would need to be walked in a quiet area, free from off-lead dogs who may try to approach them.

Both Dickie and Fregs are doing great with their progress on-lead but still require ongoing support from their future owners to prevent pulling.

They are both highly food- motivated and have found that their training can be very successful when treats are introduced! These two are great at sharing and regularly swap their treats while eating. Sharing is caring!

If you’re fond of sloppy kisses, keen on chatty dogs, and are up for the challenge of training these two wannabe Alaskan Sled Dogs, then Fregs and Dickie might be for you!

name: Dickie (& Fregs)
description:
Meet Dickie and Fregs, a father and son duo that are searching for their forever home.

Fregs loves humans and will try to kiss any new people he meets! He is very people-oriented, enjoys following his humans around, and gets a lot out of his human relationships.

Dickie is the older, wiser, more stoic of the duo, enjoying affection with his humans whilst also enjoying his own space too. Dickie likes a good nap at his humans’ side, enjoys his food and walks, and has always shared a strong bond with his son Fregs. Dickie inspires confidence in Fregs, and he can be seen imitating Dickie’s behaviour and following in his footsteps. Like any good dad, he leads by example, and like any good son, Fregs looks to Dickie for guidance.

They both enjoy their walks but can get a bit overwhelmed when seeing other dogs out on a walk. Dickie and Fregs would need to be walked in a quiet area, free from off-lead dogs who may try to approach them.

Both Dickie and Fregs are doing great with their progress on-lead but still require ongoing support from their future owners to prevent pulling.

They are both highly food- motivated and have found that their training can be very successful when treats are introduced! These two are great at sharing and regularly swap their treats while eating. Sharing is caring!

If you’re fond of sloppy kisses, keen on chatty dogs, and are up for the challenge of training these two wannabe Alaskan Sled Dogs, then Fregs and Dickie might be for you!

name: Rae
description:
If you're looking for a little Rae of sunshine, you've just found her.

Sweet, affectionate, endlessly friendly and always ready for her next adventure, Rae is the kind of dog who makes every day feel a little bit brighter.

This clever girl has plenty of energy for adventures and loves getting out and about. When Rae isn't off enjoying her walks, she's at home showing off her second favourite hobby... digging! Rae is convinced every garden is hiding buried treasure, and she's appointed herself Chief Archaeologist to uncover it. Whether she's following an interesting scent or proudly admiring her latest excavation, she tackles every project with complete determination.

Her absolute best quality, though, is her love for people. Rae simply wants to be wherever you are. If she could magically shrink down and live in your pocket as your own little pocketful of sunshine, she absolutely would. She adores attention, thrives on affection and has never met a person she didn't want to be friends with. Whether you're relaxing on the sofa or pottering around the house, Rae will happily be your shadow, hoping there's a cuddle or ear scratch coming her way.

We're looking for an active home in a quieter area away from busy roads that can offer Rae plenty of adventures, enrichment and, ideally, a garden where the occasional dig spot won't cause too much heartbreak.

Adopt Rae today and we can almost guarantee a forecast of bright days, warm cuddles and a lifetime of sunshine.

name: Reenie
description:
Meet ‘teenie weenie’ Reenie

Reenie is a sweet and affectionate Greyhound looking for a patient home where she can enjoy life as a much-loved pet. As an ex-racer, she is still learning about home life and may need support settling into a routine, including house training and becoming accustomed to everyday household sights and sounds.

She enjoys her daily walks and loves the chance to have a run in a secure paddock before stretching out and relaxing on a comfy bed. Reenie will need access to a secure garden or regular access to a secure area for off-lead exercise. Due to her high prey drive, she must remain on lead when out and about and cannot live with cats or small animals.

Reenie can be around other dogs provided introductions are carried out carefully and at her pace. She generally prefers calm, low-key interactions and may be able to live with another Greyhound following successful introductions.

Reenie could live with primary school-aged children who understand the importance of giving her space when resting, as she can experience sleep startle and should always be left undisturbed while asleep.

This lovely girl is ready to leave her racing career behind and settle into a comfortable home where she can relax, build her confidence, and enjoy being part of the family.

name: Arlo
description:
Arlo is an affectionate and intelligent boy who is looking for an active home that can continue building on the great foundations he already has. Arlo can struggle to share his resources with people and other dogs, so we are looking for a home with secondary school aged children and no other pets in the home. He will need ongoing support with managing him around his food, and the team here can explain how to manage his environment and reinforce his recall to help him make good choices.

He loves people and is always keen to make new friends, often greeting visitors with lots of enthusiasm and a desire for attention. Arlo is keen to learn and already knows a range of cues and commands. He is highly motivated by food, toys and praise, and would love to learn new tricks and skills in his new home. He enjoys walks, and has excellent recall off lead. However, he will scavenge and try to pick up food while out and about, so ongoing training and management around this will be especially important, as he has a very sensitive tummy and needs a consistent diet.

If you are looking for an active, clever and fun companion who is eager to learn, Arlo could be a match for you - he will make a wonderful addition to the right home.

name: Angel
description:
Meet Angel, a characterful lady who loves to meet people, enjoy a good fuss and have a good time. She is happy to meet old and new friends alike; new owners will need to be aware of this because she is a stocky dog who could knock people over by accident.

Angel enjoys the simple pleasures in life but will need support with settling in to home life.

After a good walk, she enjoys lounging on the sofa, having some fuss, or basking in the sun.

Angel could live with older children, who are confident around larger dogs as she can be bouncy and a bit of a thug - typical of her breed! Angel enjoys saying hello to dogs here at the centre and will happily share walks with a new friend. She could live with a canine companion who enjoys bull breed style of play.

Things that are less familiar to Angel can sometimes be a little worrying for her causing Angel to bark so she might need some help in her new home.

Flat faced (brachycephalic) dogs suffer from additional health problems, which may impact their quality of life. We always recommend anyone thinking about adopting or buying a flat faced (brachycephalic) dog to thoroughly research the breed beforehand. Our expert team will be able to give you tips on exercise and weight management and advice on any support Angel may need.

if you have a sofa big enough for this cuddle-bug then please apply for her today.

name: Daisy
description:
Our Daisy has such a zest for life and loves to be out exploring, getting all the sniffs in on her walks and being part of the family.

Daisy is such a gentle girl who loves everyone she meets. She does sometimes get excitable when meeting new humans so we are teaching her that all the love comes when she has 4 paws on the floor.

Daisy has lived with children before and could do so again in her new home.

She could potentially live with a well matched dog, that has lived with dogs before, pending meets at the centre.

Due to Daisy having a high prey drive, she wouldn't be able to live with cats or small animals.

If you think you could offer Daisy a comfy spot on the sofa and a place in your heart, then we look forward to hearing from you.

name: Shaxx
description:
Meet the stunning Shaxx!

Shaxx is a full of life, young German Shepard. He is a gorgeous boy with lots of love to give. Shaxx is looking for a home where his new owners can be home for some of the day to keep him company. He will also be looking for owners who can continue his basic training needs.

Pending on successful meets here at the centre, Shaxx has the potential to live with another dog. The resident dog would need to of lived with a dog before, or be used to a large bouncy dog.  He wouldn't be able to live with other pets.

Shaxx could live with older teenage children in his new home, that are used to large dogs.

Shaxx is strong on lead and will need owners who are physically able to handle him, to be able to meet his exercise needs. Knowledge of the German Shepard breed is desirable but not a must.

if you think you could offer our Super Shaxx a new home, then we look forward to hearing from you.

name: Watson
description:
Meet Watson, a one-year-old Crossbreed with a friendly, playful personality and plenty of youthful energy! This bouncy, enthusiastic boy loves to have fun and would thrive with an active family who enjoy getting out and about, as well as spending time playing together. Watson is still young and has lots to learn, so he will need patient, committed owners who are experienced with strong, excitable dogs and are happy to continue his training socialisation  He can become overexcited during play , so he will need guidance to help him channel his enthusiasm appropriately. Watson could live in an adult-only home or one with children aged 16 years and over, where everyone understands his bouncy nature and can help him learn to settle.

Watson could potentially live with another dog of a similar size and build who would be comfortable with his energetic play style, although he may benefit most from being the only dog in the home while he develops his training and manners. If he is your only dog, his new family should be committed to keeping him well socialised and providing plenty of positive experiences with other dogs. An active home that can offer regular exercise, enrichment, training and appropriate playtime would be ideal for this fun-loving young boy.  With time, consistency and plenty of positive encouragement, Watson has the potential to grow into a wonderful companion. Could you be the family ready to help this lovable youngster become the very best version of himself?

name: Louie & Reggie
description:
Louie & Reggie are a young duo of 1 & 2 years old who are looking for a new home together. They are young, playful boys who are looking for a home where they can have lots of adventures and be a part of the family. They could potentially live with another dog/s pending a successful meet and older Primary school children.

Reggie & Louie have always lived together and are now in one of our wonderful foster homes together, they enjoy zooming around on their walks and in the garden, followed by cuddling up on the sofa. They are super affectionate boys who would like to be able to cuddle on the sofa and have lots of TLC in their new home as although they are generally super confident and loving, they can sometimes be a little but worried, but soon warm up. They are pretty much completely clean in the house an are sleeping in their crates through the night with no issues.

name: Darcy & Milo
description:
Darcy and Milo are a wonderful, lively pair of Shih Tzu's who are looking for a home together. They love meeting new people, getting out and about exploring and then chilling out on the sofa. They are looking for a new home where they can be a part of the family and won't be left home alone for extended periods of time. Any children in their new home would be of an older primary school age and respectful of their space and they could live with another dog pending a successful meet at the centre.

Darcy and Milo both love a cuddle on the sofa and going out on little adventures to meet new people and see new places. They aso enjoy playing with their toys and can be left home alone after they settle in and as long as they are together. This lovable duo can be a little bit chatty when thy first meet new dogs but settle once they have met and get on great with them. They are very foody dogs and would love to put this to use and doing some basic training with their new humans. Milo and Darcy may need to be reminded of their housetraining in a new home so a paitnt understanding new home would be needed for them to help them start again, they have also previously lived with cats so this too may be an option. This duo are very bonded and would be required to stay toether in their new home so we are hoping there is a special family out there looking for a special lovable duo to join them!

name: Alfie
description:
Alfie is looking for an active home who want to teach him some fun skills and put his brain to use. He prefers the company of humans, so much so, that he would prefer to to be the only pet in the home. Alfie mostly will ignore dogs out and about, especially if you have a ball for a distraction. Alfie likes to keep things that he finds on the floor and may resist handing them over over, so an older teen -adult home would be more suitable for him in these situations. Alfie likes to sleep in a cosy crate den overnight as he finds this comforting and is he is fully housetrained. Alfie travels well in the car, he just needs a little helping hand getting in. Alfie's adopters will need to commit to helping him on his weight loss journey, so that he can fully enjoy going on adventures!

Alfie thrives when he is outdoors and playing with his ball and will be perfect for an active household. He can live with children of late teenage and upwards who will also follow the advice given when Alfie does pick up items he shouldn't have and understand not to take things directly off him. Further training is essential for Alfie, so if you feel you have the time and patience to help Alfie move forward in his new journey, then please click that favourite button! He will be worth the effort.

name: Winnie
description:
Winnie is an adorable 4 month old Terrier mix pup who is looking for an active, terrier savvy new home to call her own. Winnie is lovable, cheeky and full of fun, but despite her age, is very switched on and has many of the typical terrier traits and also needs to keep her busy brain engaged. She could live with younger secondary aged children an above, and other dogs pending a successful meet at our centre.

Winnie is a very intelligent pup who is also very food motivated so would make the perfect training partner! Winnie is a typical puppy and doesn't know when to go nap so needs guidance in her new home to set a suitable, enrichment routine for her including her naps, toilet training and socialisation. Winnie would make the perfect companion for an active household, who, as she grows up, wants to take Winnie on exciting adventures.

name: Bruce
description:
Bruce is a lovely, gentle and curious 6-year-old French Bulldog who enjoys nothing more than getting outdoors and exploring the world around him. He absolutely loves human attention and will happily soak up all the fuss, cuddles and brushing you can offer, especially when he’s the centre of your attention! Bruce is a friendly, enthusiastic boy who greets new people with plenty of excitement and is always happy to make new friends. He can be friendly and tolerant around other dogs, although he does have an independent side and enjoys doing his own thing. Bruce is also a great little travel companion, happily riding in the back of the car and ready to join you on days out and holidays. With plenty of energy to burn, he’ll love a family who can offer him regular walks, outdoor adventures and lots of quality time together.

Bruce is looking for an active, loving home where he can enjoy all the attention and companionship his heart desires. He could potentially live alongside another compatible dog but he would be equally happy as the only dog in the home, where he can enjoy being the centre of attention. Bruce can sometimes be a little jumpy and nervous around playful children, so a home with secondary school-aged children or older would be best suited to him. His new family will also need to be prepared to introduce any time left alone gradually, helping him build confidence and settle into a new routine at his own pace. If you’re looking for a friendly, affectionate companion who will happily join you on adventures, enjoy long walks and then soak up all the cuddles on offer, Bruce could be the perfect addition to your family!

name: Ffion
description:
Meet beautiful girl, Ffion! Ffion is a 4.5-year old Dachshund looking for her forever home! Ffion is looking to be the only dog in the home, as she can find seeing dogs quite worrying and can be vocal, in typical Daxi style. Ffion is looking for a home where all children are secondary school aged and above, as she is super lovely once she gets to know you but can be nervous meeting new people initially. Ffion would love a patient, understanding family that are happy to work on her confidence, and give her a nice quiet place to settle down. She would prefer a quieter environment to live and to walk while she comes out of her shell, but will be very affectionate and sweet once bonded. 
Ffion is a lovely lady who would love for her new family to be with her for the majority of the day while she settles in, as she hasn't been left on her own in a home before. She may also need some support with her house-training, but loves a bit of ham and chicken so we're sure that with some food motivation, she'll pick this up in no time! Ffion will be a wonderful addition to the family.

Ffion is a very beautiful girl, with a lot of love to give. She can be shy meeting new people, and worried of loud noises so would prefer a quieter home where she can come out of her shell at her own pace. Ffion is quite easy-going and calm in kennels, and is happy to be handled despite being a bit spooked at times. Once comfortable with her people, Ffion will enjoy a lovely fuss and a cuddle on the sofa. We can't wait to see her find her forever home!

name: Blue
description:
Blue is a two-year-old German Shepherd looking for a quiet and loving home with a fully secure garden. He could share his home with upper secondary school aged children. He is looking to be the only dog in the home with potential to live with one in the future; Blue needs to get to know dogs gradually. He would benefit from having social doggy pals when out and about. Blue has no history around cats, small furries, or livestock. He is housetrained. He travels well in the boot of the car. Blue is happy to be left alone for a few hours at a time. Experience of the breed would be helpful. Blue is a sensitive boy and can be nervous so he would benefit from predictability and routine. Potential adopters should expect to come to the centre a few times to build up a friendship with Blue before adoption.

Gorgeous Blue whose nickname is Bluey, is sweet but nervous. He is devoted and loyal to his people. Blue is happiest when he is curled up next to you on the sofa. He enjoys a fuss and a snuggle with his trusted people. He loves treats including Bonios and sweet potato. His quirks include, ‘if you open the freezer, he expects an ice-cube!’ He doesn’t love the rain! Blue knows a sit, paw, spin, wait, and back! He prefers his walks in quieter locations where he can relax and take in lots of sniffs. He was fine to visit a Pets at Home store recently. He enjoys a paddle in shallow water. He is happy to meet up and socialise with familiar dogs and familiar people and roam about off his lead with his doggy pals. He can be worried by big dogs and dogs he does not yet know. Blue enjoys playing with toys, he likes soft toys, and a game of fetch and tug.

name: Bella
description:
Bella  is a approx. 4 -year-old Patterdale cross who is a nervous little girl looking for a patient and understanding home where she can feel safe and secure. She is gradually building trust with her carers, although she can still be wary at times. Bella can find new people and situations worrying, so she needs adopters who will give her plenty of time and never rush her. She loves having a quiet, cosy space to retreat to when she feels overwhelmed. She is a clever girl whose housetraining is coming along well but will need ongoing positive reward based training in the home along with patience and reassurance, once she feels comfortable with her humans her naturally friendly personality will shine through. Any potential adopters will need to meet multiple times here at the centre and be available for home visits before going home.

Bella is looking for a adult only home with minimal visitors. She is starting to enjoy her walks and explore the world but can get overwhelmed, she will need a understanding family that can work at Bella's pace. She can potentially live with a calm, confident dog who can help her feel secure (neutered if male). Use of a secure outdoor space would be a benefit as she negotiates the outside world.  Bella's ideal home will be a calm environment with patient adopters who understand that building her confidence will take time. If you're looking for a sweet little girl who needs someone to believe in her and help her discover how wonderful life can be, Bella could be the perfect companion for you.

name: Trent
description:
Trent can live with children of high school age but is more suited to being the only pet. He is house trained but not used to being alone for any length of time, so would need his adopters to build up any alone time gradually.

Trent has been very popular since his arrival at our centre with his happy friendly nature and slight odd appearance! He's a young Staffy Beagle cross, very active and has been enjoying exploring the centre and park next door. In his previous home, Trent liked to chew objects that had been left within his reach, such as shoes and clothing, so best to make sure he has appropriate toys to chew on and things to do if he's by himself, and to keep personal items out of reach. Trent has happily greeted other dogs that he's met but doesn't really pursue any further interaction, taking himself off to do something else. He's probably happy enough to be the only dog at home, but some walking friends might be nice for him just to keep him socialised. Trent is a very playful boy and gets lovely and boisterous when the toys come out! His favourites are tuggies and chasing anything that you throw for him. Car travel doesn't seem to be an issue for him, he jumped in ours quite happily and he does know a few cues.

name: Rocket
description:
Meet this gorgeous boy, Rocket! Rocket is a 1-year old Malamute X Bull Terrier looking for his forever home. Rocket is a wonderful boy, who would make a fantastic family dog! He is very sweet and polite when meeting new people and dogs alike, and has been brought up around dogs and young children. For this reason, he could live with another dog in the home pending a successful meet here at the centre, and children primary school age and above. 
Rocket loves to play with his toys, and is a real foodie! He is also very keen to learn and receptive to training, so will be such a fun dog to work with and any ongoing training will be a doddle. Rocket is looking for an active home, as he is very high energy and loves to get out and about. He does pull on lead and can be very strong so needs confident, competent owners to work on this with him.
Rocket is fully house-trained and travels well in the car, so would make a wonderful adventure companion! Rocket does have a strong prey drive, so will need to be kept on lead when out for walks, but is happy to explore on a long line to get all his sniffs in!

Rocket is a gorgeous boy with a big personality. He will make a cracking family dog, and is wonderful meeting new people - though can sometimes jump up, but tries his best to be a polite boy! He is confident in new environments and is a well-rounded boy, despite being so young. He is great with handling, and absolutely loves a cuddle from his people. He is good in the vets, though, isn't keen on his nails being clipped! 
He would prefer for his leaving hours to be built up slowly in a new environment, especially if he'll be the only dog in the home, as he is used to being left with his doggy friends. We can't wait to see this gorgeous boy living it up in his forever home!!

name: Angus
description:
Angus is a friendly, curious 7-month-old Jack Russell/Patterdale Terrier cross looking for a loving home where he can get plenty of attention while he discovers more about the world. He would like to be the only dog at home, but can have doggy friends when out and about. He could live with secondary school-aged children who understand when he needs a bit of space. He also has the potential to live with other pets, pending successful introduction, and provided any interactions are carefully managed. As a young pup, Angus will need lots of snooze time and once he is settled in his new home, his new family will support him by gradually building up the time when he is left on his own. He has been happy being left for around an hour before he settles down for a sleep. Angus is a bright, inquisitive puppy already learning the basics, like sit and paw, and he would thrive with an active family who will love and guide him as he grows.

Angus is a cuddly chap who loves being close to his people and would much rather be snuggled up on your lap than sit anywhere else! He is still finding his feet in the world, so he'll need patience, encouragement and plenty of fun along the way. He's got lots to learn, but he is already making a good start and he loves a game of chase with his big, soft toys. If you've got the time to help a young dog learn, grow in confidence and enjoy all the fun of puppyhood, Angus will be very happy to share his cuddles and playtime with you.

name: Huck
description:
Huck is looking for an active and loving home where he can enjoy plenty of exercise, playtime and companionship. As an intelligent 4-year-old Border Collie, he will benefit from having opportunities to keep both his body and mind busy.

Huck would suit a home in a quiet area away from noisy or busy traffic. A secure private garden would be ideal as he loves to run and play.

Huck really enjoys the company of other dogs so with the right match, he could potentially live with another dog. However, he cannot live with other pets. He has grown up with children and could live with them, although he generally prefers to do his own thing, occasionally joining in their games.

Huck can currently be left for a couple of hours, but if he needs to be left for longer periods, his adopters would need to introduce this gradually and build up over time.

Huck is looking for someone who will love his affectionate nature, provide him with plenty of exercise and attention and give him the time and patience to settle into his new home.

Huck is a super-friendly, affectionate boy who absolutely loves people. He is the sort of dog who is very happy to approach you for a fuss and will happily nudge your hand when he thinks he deserves some attention!

He loves being around people and also enjoys the company of other dogs. He is an intelligent and active boy who loves to run and play, and his previous owner tells us that he particularly enjoys playing with balls and sticks.

Despite his energetic side, Huck also knows how to settle. When his owner was busy doing paperwork, he was happy to lie quietly under the table, showing that he can relax when things are calm.

Huck is seeking a new home through no fault of his own and has loads of love and fun to offer. For the right person or family, he could be a fantastic buddy — an affectionate, playful and clever boy who will be happiest with plenty of attention, exercise and fun.

If you are looking for a friendly, people-loving Border Collie to share your adventures with, Huck could be the boy for you.

name: Marley
description:
Older gent Marley is a fan of the laid-back lifestyle as well as having moments of giddiness. He can’t wait to enjoy the home luxuries in a calm set up. Marley has previously been housetrained, and alone time can be introduced once he’s found his paws. Marley adores company but also enjoys his own space especially when tucking into a tasty treat. This golden oldie will be best matched to living with older teens who share the understanding of when Marley is needing some space. Marley is looking to be the only dog in the home although may have calm and polite walking pals.

Marley is a fantastic 8-year-old guy who is bursting with love. He loves to make new friends and enjoys a bum scratch although, he does like his own space too. Marley is a fan of snoozing by your feet after a mooch around exploring. He’s partial to a bit of people watching basking in the sun too. Marley will make someone a fabulous companion.

name: Eve
description:
I need a calm and quiet home where I can settle in at my own pace.

I can be an only dog or live with other dogs. I have never met cats.

I will need a secure garden with minimum 6ft fencing.

I am learning to walk on a lead and harness, but it's still very new for me.

I am in a foster home now so am learning all about home life and house training.

I have been spayed & am ready for my forever home!

Eve is a sweet girl who has come to us from a breeder ready to find her forever home. When she first arrived she was a very scared little girl who was understandably finding the world quite overwhelming.

Eve has recently moved to a wonderful foster home where she is getting to experience home life for the first time and it has been such a joy watching her settle in to home life. Her confidence has progressed incredibly and given where she started, her resilience and curiosity are nothing short of amazing. She can still be a bit skittish around sudden movements, but is doing so well.

Eve does gain confidence from other dogs and would love to have another kind and confident resident dog in her new home, however in the right circumstances with experienced adopters who have plenty of time to spend with her, we would consider homing her as an only dog. She does value her personal space and isn't keen on sharing her bed with other dogs and can guard it from them, so it will be essential that her adopters would be happy to manage this behaviour and work on it with her.

Eve loves her food and a slow feeder bowl is an absolute must for her, otherwise she’d clear her plate in seconds. She’s also masterfully tuned in to the household and already knows the exact sound of the snack cupboards opening and the rustle of a crisp packet!

She tackled learning the stairs almost immediately and navigates them like a pro now. Her toilet training and walking on a lead nad harness are coming along nicely, though they will just need a bit of ongoing, gentle guidance in her forever home as she continues to build routine and confidence.

Eve will be best suited to a calm and quiet home where she can continue to settle in and progress at her own pace, but with time, love and kindness we think she will truly blossom into the most wonderful girl.

She has some sore and inflamed paw pads when she first arrived at the rescue and also has a travel document.

Eve has been given the Gift of Life by Anne Breen

Meet Eve: The Sweet, Confident Cocker Spaniel Looking for Her Forever Home!

Eve came into foster care with us almost four weeks ago, and it has been such a joy watching her settle into home life!

I’ve owned and fostered many Cocker Spaniels over the years, and Eve stands out as one of the most delightfully confident ones I’ve met. Because of her background, she can still be a bit skittish or nervous around sudden movements, but given where she started, her resilience and curiosity are nothing short of amazing.

Here is a little glimpse into life with Eve:

Dog-Friendly & Independent: She shares her foster home with a whole pack of dogs and gets along fine with everyone. That said, she values her personal space especially when it comes to her bed! (Honestly, who amongst us likes sharing a mattress?) She would thrive living either as an only dog or alongside other canine companions. She’s also quite independent and comfortable being left happily for a few hours.

Foodie at Heart: Eve loves her food! A slow feeder bowl is an absolute must for her, otherwise she’d clear her plate in seconds. She’s also masterfully tuned in to the household—she already knows the exact sound of the snack cupboards opening and the rustle of a crisp packet!

Household Progress: She tackled learning the stairs almost immediately and navigates them like a pro now. Her toilet training and lead/harness walking are coming along nicely, though they will just need a bit of ongoing, gentle guidance in her forever home as she continues to build routine and confidence.

Eve is an absolute beauty inside and out. She is ready for a patient, loving home where she can continue to blossom into the wonderful companion she’s proving to be.

Eve is a nervous girl who has come into our care from a breeder.

She is a very scared little girl who is understandably finding the world quite overwhelming. Eve relies heavily on the comfort of her doggy friends and is currently very skittish. She is a flight risk, so her new family will need to take great care to ensure she always feels safe and secure while she settles into her new life.

Eve will need another kind, confident dog in the home to take her under their wing and be a much-needed support system to help guide her, build her confidence, and reassure her as she settles in and finds her paws.

As Eve has never lived in a home before, she will need to learn all about house training, lead training, and the other basics of home life. Her adopters will need to be patient and understanding, allowing her to progress at her own pace without any pressure.

Eve is looking for a calm, adult-only home with confident adopters who understand that building trust will take time. A secure garden and a confident resident dog will be essential to help her adjust safely and gently to home life.

Eve is a gentle soul who has a long journey ahead of her, but every small step forward will be a huge achievement. With time, patience, and the support of a confident canine companion, we hope she will gradually discover that the world isn't such a scary place after all.

She is currently being monitored for sore and inflamed paw pads, and this will need to be monitored in her new home.

name: Kelsy
description:
I can live with older dog-savvy children who understand I need time to settle in.

I need a doggy friend in my new home. I haven’t met cats so I’m unsure.

I will need an extra secure garden, at least 6ft+ where I will be safe!

I haven't tried walks yet, a secure garden will be fine for now.

Please be patient with me, I need to learn house training and lead walking

I am spayed and ready to find my forever home.

09-10-26 Kelsey is a pretty and petite girly who has come into our care from a breeder in search of a new start. She is easy to handle and is not too nervous, which is lovely to see. Kelsey has been caught climbing here at the rescue, so she will need a very secure garden with high, flat fencing to make sure she stays safe.

We believe that Kelsey will need another kind dog in her new home, and this dog will be a much-needed support system for her as she settles in and gets used to all the new experiences that come with home life. She can live with older, dog-savvy children who are sensible and understand she needs time to settle in.

As Kelsey has never lived in a home before, she will need to learn all about house training, lead training and the other basics of home life. Her new family will need to give her time, patience and encouragement while she learns. She has been known to climb at the rescue, and will need a fenced garden of at least 6ft that will keep her safe.

Kelsey is a sweet little girl who has already shown us that she can cope well with gentle handling, and we hope that with the support of a canine companion and a loving family, she will continue to grow in confidence and enjoy her happy new start.

Kelsy has been given the Gift of Life by Sarah Parmenter

name: Kylie
description:
I can live with older teenagers, aged 16+, who understand I need time to settle in.

I need a doggy friend in my new home. I haven’t met cats so I’m unsure.

I'd like a secure garden to potter around in.

I haven't tried walks just yet and will find this a bit overwhelming at the moment.

I am in a foster home now so am learning all about home life and house training.

I have been spayed & am ready for my forever home!

Kylie is a sweet little girl who came to us from a breeder and has now moved to a wonderful foster home, where she is beginning to experience home life for the first time. She has a sweet, gentle nature and is a curious, active little girl who is slowly finding her feet and starting to settle into her new surroundings.

Kylie loves having other dogs around her and takes great comfort from their company, so will need another kind and friendly dog of a similar size in her new home who enjoys sharing their bed and having a little playmate around. Having another dog to follow and learn from will be a great help as she continues to build her confidence.

Although she is startling to enjoy a gentle fuss, she is still a little unsure and isn't quite ready to ask for attention herself just yet. She enjoys following her fosterer around and is gradually learning that people can be kind. With time, patience and reassurance, we hope to see her confidence continue to grow.

Kylie is doing well with her toilet training when given regular opportunities to go out into the garden. She is also a little foodie and is always keen to investigate what might be in everyone else's bowl, so mealtimes may need a little supervision!

She has started learning to wear a harness, but isn't quite ready to go for walks just yet and will need to start with gentle practice in the garden when she feels comfortable.

As Kylie has never lived in a home before, she will need patient adopters who understand that all these experiences are new to her and who can help her learn at her own pace. She will also need someone around for most of the day while she settles into her new routine, with any time left alone introduced gradually as her confidence grows. Kylie can live with sensible, dog-savvy teenagers aged 16 and over who will give her the space and time she needs to feel safe.

Kylie is making a lovely start in foster and has so much potential to blossom into a happy, confident little companion. With a loving family, a reassuring canine friend and plenty of patience, we hope she will continue to discover just how wonderful life can be and find the forever home she deserves.

Kylie has been given the Gift of Life by Claire Loughlin

Kylie has made a good start in foster. She has a sweet gentle nature, is curious, active, shadows her fosterer and sleeps quietly all night with her foster buddy Kismet in a crate and greets me in the morning with a lovely waggy tail.Kylie is a foodie and will eat from every bowl she can get her sweet head into. With regular visits to the garden she is doing well with toilet training. Harness training has started but lead walking will wait until she is more trusting and then start in the garden. She accepts a gentle fuss but will not ask for attention yet.Kylie needs a home with at least one similar size play mate who likes to cosy up and share their bed as she takes great comfort from the presence of other dogs. She needs owners where someone is around most of the time while she settles into a new routine. Time alone will need to be built up gradually.

Kylie is a lively little girl who has come into our care from a breeder. She is a very happy girl who enjoys some gentle fuss and attention. Kylie will allow herself to be picked up and carried and is happy to settle in our arms, although she is not the most confident little girl and can still be a little unsure.

Kylie gets on wonderfully with her kennel friends and takes comfort from having other dogs around her. Because of this, she will need a kind resident dog in her new home to help guide her and provide the reassurance and companionship she needs as she settles in and gets used to her new surroundings. She can live with older, dog-savvy teens aged 16+ who are sensible and will allow her time to settle in.

As Kylie has never lived in a home before, she will need to learn all about house training, lead training and the other basics of home life. Her new family will need to give her plenty of patience and encouragement while she learns and adjusts to everything that is new to her.

Kylie is a cheerful little girl who has lots of personality waiting to shine through. With the help of a reassuring canine companion and a loving family, we hope she will gradually become more confident and enjoy the happy new start she deserves.
