In his foster home, Pongo is continuing to grow and learn about the world around him. He is slowly becoming accustomed to everyday things such as walking on a lead and meeting new people.

While he still needs a bit of time to build confidence, he is making steady progress and learning that people can be kind and trustworthy.

Pongo has a naturally gentle and affectionate personality. Once he gets to know someone, his sweet and friendly side quickly appears. His sociable character makes him a lovely companion who enjoys positive interactions and calm encouragement.

He is also known to get along well with other dogs and cats. This shows that he has a friendly and tolerant temperament when around other animals. With continued guidance and a patient environment, he can continue developing his social skills and confidence.

What Pongo needs most now is a family willing to offer him patience, security, and love. A calm home where he can feel safe will help him continue blossoming into the confident dog he is meant to be.

With the right people beside him, his shy side will gradually fade as his trusting and affectionate nature grows stronger.

Adopting Pongo means giving a deserving dog the stable and loving future he has been waiting for. In return, he will offer loyalty, sweetness, and companionship to the family who welcomes him into their lives.

He is simply waiting for someone to give him the chance to belong.

name: Oliver
description:
Oliver is a 1 year old male Hound Cross, a medium to large sized boy weighing around 18–20 kilograms who is currently outside the UK.

Oliver, a handsome young hound mix is with a lovely black, brown and white coat and a wonderfully easygoing nature. He was found wandering alone before being brought to safety at the Residencia Garatuxa rescue in Galicia, northern Spain.

Oliver is a confident and friendly dog who enjoys the company of people and other dogs. He is social, relaxed and not nervous or dominant, making him an easy companion to have around.

At the shelter he mixes well with the other dogs and shows a gentle, affectionate character.

He is still a young dog, around one year old or possibly even younger, so he has his whole life ahead of him and will make a wonderful addition to a family willing to give him the love and stability he deserves. He can be cat tested and child tested if required.

Oliver will be fully prepared for travel — vaccinated, microchipped, neutered and with his passport ready — and can travel to the UK to the right home.

If you are looking for a young, friendly dog who will quickly become part of the family, Oliver could be the perfect match.

As with all of our dogs, he comes with full rescue back-up.

name: Monty
description:
Monty is a 5-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is described as a medium-sized dog and is currently in foster care in Hartlepool. He arrived in the UK in September 2025 after spending three years in Romanian foster kennels.

When Monty first arrived, he was very nervous and shy in his new surroundings. Since then, he has grown greatly in confidence and has shown himself to be a wonderful and loving dog. He is now ready to find a caring and permanent home of his own.

Monty is a very cuddly dog who forms strong bonds once he learns to trust someone. He is described as having a soft nature and being full of love. He is especially affectionate with people he knows well.

He walks nicely on a lead, which helps make his daily exercise more manageable. Although he has made great progress, he can still be nervous when meeting new people and dogs while out on walks.

Because of this, he would benefit from an understanding adopter who can continue to build his confidence at his own pace.

Monty is good with other dogs and enjoys their company. He has not been tested with cats, and he has also not been tested with children. Any introductions in these areas would need to be handled carefully and thoughtfully.

He is up to date with his vaccinations and has been neutered. Full rescue backup is provided, offering ongoing support after adoption. Monty is currently based in Hartlepool but can travel to the right home.

name: Rosie
description:
Rosie is a 1 year old female cross-breed with unique and lovely markings. DOB 10/7/2023.

Abandoned in woodland with her siblings at a tender age, she found refuge in a foster shelter, where she currently resides.

Rosie, a good-sized medium dog, walks well on a lead, great with other dogs & older children.

This resilient pup has undergone thorough veterinary care, including comprehensive blood tests, ensuring her seamless integration into life in the UK.

Ideal for an experienced family well-versed in dog ownership, Rosie is best suited for a household with children over 8 years old, given her size.

She comes fully vaccinated, microchipped, and equipped with a pet passport and medical papers detailing her health history.

The commitment to her well-being extends beyond adoption, with the assurance of lifetime rescue backup and ongoing support from the dedicated rescue centre.

For households with feline companions, a cat test can be conducted to assess Rosie’s compatibility.

The rescue centre emphasises their dedication to the welfare of their dogs, offering not just a new family member but a guarantee of continuous support for Rosie’s lifetime.

name: Miro
description:
Miro is a large, 3-year-old male Romanian Shepherd, born on 10th November 2020. He has been neutered, possesses a passport, and is up-to-date on vaccinations.

Currently located in kennels in the UK, Miro found a family in November but is now back, awaiting that special someone who can offer him a forever home.

Despite his heartbreaking return to kennels, Miro remains affectionate and is a superb cuddler. Desperate for love, he quickly forms strong bonds with those around him.

In search of an extraordinary home, Miro requires a quiet rural or semi-rural setting with a spacious and secure garden. Ideally, his new home should be an adult-only environment without other animals.

Potential adopters must have experience with large-breed Romanian Shepherds, and be willing to invest time in building a relationship with Miro, his trainer, and the team familiar with him.

Miro, being sensitive to his surroundings, needs someone patient, who can ensure he feels comfortable and safe.

While Miro can be overwhelmed by his environment, in the right home, he proves to be an exceptionally loyal companion. Engaging in scent training has not only showcased his natural ability but also helped reduce his anxiety.

It’s essential to note that Miro can be reactive on a lead and may struggle with reading other dogs. Despite his strength, he walks beautifully on a lead and is comfortable wearing a muzzle, a requirement for his safety.

Prospective adopters must commit to having him wear a muzzle at all times outside the house and a double lead.

name: Harley
description:
Harley is a 6-month-old male Cross-breed, born on 29th July 2021, with a large-sized stature standing at 64cm, chest measuring 78cm, and neck circumference at 46cm.

Rescued from an unfortunate situation, Harley, along with his eight siblings, was discovered abandoned and hungry at a chicken abattoir in Romania.

After their rescue, they found temporary refuge in a friend’s yard, where a large kennel run was set up for them until space became available at Happy’s, where Harley is currently residing.

Harley, a sweet and lively young dog, has adapted well to his new environment at Happy’s. Despite the tragic loss of one of his brothers, Casper, Harley is in good health.

Neutered and up-to-date with vaccinations, he is ready for adoption. His ideal family should be willing to dedicate time to care for him, provide support for his development, and engage in training activities.

Harley has proven to be friendly and sociable, getting along well with other dogs, cats, and goats. However, caution is advised around chickens as he does not interact positively with them.

For those considering adopting Harley and meeting his needs, the rehoming process involves filling out a registration form. The rehoming team at Happy’s will then be in touch to facilitate the adoption process.

name: Trixie
description:
Trixie is a small 5 month old female Jack Russell Cross puppy, born on 28th March 2026, who is expected to remain a small adult.

Trixie is currently cared for in our small, cage-free home rescue in Bulgaria and is available for adoption to families in the UK.

She was found abandoned with her two brothers on a building site in Bulgaria. Thankfully, those difficult days are now behind them, and all three puppies are safe, healthy and thriving while they wait for their forever homes.

Trixie is a happy, playful little girl with a wonderful zest for life. She loves exploring, playing with the other puppies and then curling up for cuddles when it’s time to relax.

She is friendly, affectionate and enjoys human company, making friends wherever she goes.

She is full of confidence without being overwhelming and has the bright, curious personality that makes every day an adventure.

Trixie is already showing all the qualities of a fantastic family companion and will thrive with continued training, socialisation and plenty of love as she grows.

Trixie enjoys the company of other dogs and would happily live with another friendly canine companion. Equally, she would be just as happy as the only dog in a home where she will receive lots of attention and be included in family life.

If you’re looking for a small puppy with a big personality, Trixie could be the perfect addition to your family.

At Rescue Dogs For Adoption, all of our dogs live as part of our family in a home environment rather than kennels, allowing us to understand their personalities and carefully match them with the right homes.

We consider all applicants because finding the perfect match is far more important than ticking boxes.

If you think Trixie could be the perfect addition to your family, we’d love to hear from you.

name: Johnny
description:
Johnny is a 1 year old male Cross-Breed, truly adorable little chap currently thriving in his UK foster home.

He’s neutered. At just 1 year old, lots of energy and has settled in beautifully. Johnny is a bright, cheerful soul with a wonderfully cheeky personality.

He’s making great progress with his toilet training and has just begun exploring the world on his walks. He’s good on both lead and harness, curious about everything he sees, and is gradually becoming more confident around traffic.

Johnny is living with an older female dog at the moment, but he would absolutely love a younger, playful companion to match his energy.

He cannot live with cats. He hasn’t met children yet, so we would say children aged 12+.

He is such a sweet, happy youngster who’s ready for his forever home.

name: Hershey
description:
Hershey is a 6-month-old male large-sized cross-breed dog with a height of 64cm, a chest measuring 78cm, and a neck circumference of 46cm.

He is located in Romania and has been neutered. Hershey, along with his 8 siblings, was discovered abandoned, hungry, and alone at a chicken abattoir.

Fortunately, they were taken into foster care in a friend’s yard, where a large kennel run was constructed for them until space became available at Happy’s, a rescue center.

This sweet and lively young dog has since settled well at Happy’s. Unfortunately, one of his brothers, Casper, didn’t survive, arriving too late for assistance.

Hershey is described as typical, and his new family is expected to invest time in caring for him, and providing support in terms of development and training.

Remarkably, Hershey shows compatibility with other dogs, cats, and goats, but caution is advised around chickens.

Hershey is fully vaccinated and possesses a passport. If you believe you can meet Hershey’s needs, the recommendation is to complete a registration form, and the rehoming team at Happy’s will be in touch.

name: Faye
description:
Meet Faye, a female approximately 4 years old medium/large sized Cross-Breed.

She’s nervous of new people but doesn’t take long to come around, just make sure you have plenty of treats around!

She’s a playful girl with high energy and loves nothing more than her walks.

Faye would make a very good walking companion.

Faye is very clever and very food orientated so she is easy to train.

Faye loves to play with other dogs and loves to be around people she trusts.

Faye would thrive better in a home without children as she can sometimes be unaware of her size when excited and due to her nervousness about people.

name: Arun
description:
Meet Arun. Male approximately 8-9 years old of small-medium size Cross-Breed.

Arun is looking for an adult only and pet free home.

He is a sweet, affectionate boy but it takes time for him to get to know you.

Arun space and food guards around new people so his new home must be aware of this and give him the space he needs around the home.

Arun walks lovely on the lead and enjoys group walks with the other dogs at our kennels however he would prefer to be the only dog in the home.

Arun needs an understanding home who will give him a chance. Do you have the heart to give Arun a chance at life outside of the kennels?

name: Brutus
description:
Brutus is a male Cross-Breed approximately 7 years old of medium/large size available for foster/adoption.

Nervous boy Brutus is looking for a foster or forever home to call his own.

Brutus is a very nervous boy, He hasn’t worn a lead or collar. He is nervous of noises so he will need a quiet home.

Brutus is a sweet boy and once he trusts you he enjoys a stroke behind his ears.

In the home, Brutus will need work to build up his confidence and eventually relise the world isn’t a scary place)

name: Bailey
description:
Bailey is approximately 4 years old. Medium sized male Cross-Breed.

Bailey is looking for an adult only home. He likes people and will jump to say hello when he first meets you.

He likes to fetch a toy and bring it to you as an invitation to play.

He can be nervous on walks and will lunge at passing traffic. This is something that will need further training.

Bailey is currently reactive towards cats and dogs, for this reason he would suit a home where he is the only pet to allow further training to be carried out on his reactivity.

He has met other dogs but must be supervised when he does.

Bailey is toilet trained and enjoys travelling in the car.

Bailey is not crate trained and has not been left alone at home.

name: Rolly
description:
Rolly, known as Neeko, is a 6–7 year old neutered male medium mixed breed currently in Lincolnshire.

Neeko is a gentle and affectionate boy who thrives on human company. He enjoys being close to his people and likes to be involved in daily life. Once he feels settled and secure, his loyal and loving nature becomes very apparent.

He is great with children and enjoys their company. Neeko is good with other dogs; however, he can feel overwhelmed in large groups. He would be happiest either as the only dog in the home or living with one or two calm, friendly companions.

Neeko is not suitable to live with cats, as he will chase and reacts strongly to them when out on walks.

He walks nicely on a lead when focused. If he becomes excited by other dogs or people, he responds well to guidance and can be asked to stop, sit and refocus before continuing calmly.

Neeko does not cope well with being crated and becomes stressed, so he will need a crate-free home. He settles well once he feels safe and part of a consistent routine.

Neeko would suit a loving and stable home looking for an affectionate companion. He enjoys an active lifestyle and would thrive with adopters who can offer reassurance, structure and plenty of companionship.

name: Seona and Luigi
description:
Seona is a small mixed-breed around 4 years old and Luigi is a small mixed-breed around 7 years old.

Seona and Luigi are fostered together in Staffordshire. Seona is spayed and Luigi is neutered. A reduced adoption donation applies if they are adopted together.

Their journey began with heartbreak when their elderly owner sadly passed away and they were left without care. Thankfully, a rescuer stepped in and they are now safe in foster — but they are looking for a loving forever home together.

These two are completely bonded and it would break their hearts to be separated. They truly are joined at the hip.

Both are gentle, affectionate, and well-mannered. They are housetrained, sleep soundly through the night, and greet each morning with wagging tails. They both love their food and treats.

They are comfortable walking on lead and would benefit from continued confidence-building in new walking environments. A secure garden is essential for their new home.

They are good with other dogs and play nicely with their chosen companions. They are also good with cats.

Seona is the more confident of the pair and often keeps a watchful eye over Luigi. Luigi is more submissive and sweet-natured, happily following Seona’s lead.

They adore sofa snuggles, watching television, and sitting on the windowsill observing the world.

Their foster believes they would thrive best in a quiet home with a secure garden, ideally as the only dogs where they can enjoy peace and attention together.

If you are ready for double the affection and companionship, Seona and Luigi are waiting to meet you.

name: Buddy
description:
Buddy is a 1-year-old male Jura Hound. He was born on 06/01/2025 and is currently in a shelter in the north of Spain waiting for a forever home.

He was surrendered because he was not suitable for hunting. Despite his rough start, he is still very young and capable of learning quickly.

Buddy is nervous around people but has already shown noticeable improvement since arriving at the shelter. With time and reassurance, he continues to build confidence.

He gets along well with other dogs. However, he is fed separately because he becomes anxious around food and is very enthusiastic at mealtimes.

Buddy is an active and playful dog who enjoys running around and exploring the garden. He loves using his nose and investigating scents in his surroundings.

He will need an active household willing to provide both exercise and guidance. A patient family prepared to teach him and spend quality time doing activities will suit him best.

As a scenthound with hunting training, his recall may be unreliable. Secure outdoor spaces and careful handling will therefore be important.

He would benefit from structure and routine to help him feel safe and settled. Given consistency and kindness, he should continue gaining confidence and become a loyal companion.

Full rescue back up is provided to support both Buddy and his adopters throughout the process.

name: Zar
description:
Zar is a 6-year-old male Sabueso Hound. He was born on 03/06/2019 and is currently waiting in the north of Spain for a permanent home.

He had to be urgently rescued because he was not suitable for hunting. Being in the hands of a hunter placed him in danger, so rescue intervention was necessary for his safety.

Zar is described as a very obedient dog. Despite this, he is extremely shy and clearly frightened by people due to whatever experiences he has previously endured.

He is sociable with other dogs and feels more comfortable around them. However, he still needs to learn that humans can be trusted and will not harm him.

Because he is a scenthound trained for hunting, his recall may be unreliable. His instincts are strong and secure handling will be important in everyday life.

Zar needs patience, love, and time to properly adjust to a family environment. What he truly requires is a home that will finally give him the dignity and kindness he has never known.

Full rescue back up will be provided to ensure both Zar and his adopters receive support. With understanding and consistency, he has the potential to become a devoted companion.

name: Hueso
description:
Hueso is an 8 year old male Sabueso Hound currently in foster care in Kent, UK.

Hueso is a quiet, nervous boy who needs a special person to give him time and patience to settle. He loves female humans and is more comfortable with them but he will get used to men over time.

He is not aggressive but he will avoid and try to make himself invisible.

Hueso would benefit from a kind dog to live with to help him, especially when humans need to go out, as Hueso does have separation anxiety. Ideally he needs someone who is home a lot or works from home.

He loves his walks. He is not scared of traffic or people on walks but he might sometimes bark at people. So someone who loves to go walking a couple of times a day would be great for this boy.

Hueso has luxating patella so he needs to be on supplements like YuMove and he does need some good walks at a good distance to keep him mobile plus to keep his weight at a good level.

Hueso is a scenthound and can pull on the lead after scents at times.

name: Noodle
description:
Noodle is a 1 year old male Cross-Breed. He is described as a lovely and energetic dog with a very friendly nature. Every person he has met so far has been greeted warmly and positively.

He gets along well with all other dogs he has encountered. His sociable personality makes him a pleasant companion in shared spaces. He clearly enjoys interaction and company rather than being solitary.

Noodle is comfortable wearing both his collar and harness. However, he has not yet learnt proper lead manners and can pull during walks. Continued training and guidance will be important for improving his walking behaviour.

Despite being excitable, he also enjoys affection and closeness. He happily settles down for cuddles and even thinks of himself as a lapdog. Quiet bonding time is just as important to him as active time.

His ideal home would include a good garden and plenty of opportunities for walks. Having other dogs around to play with would suit him well. After activity, he would love nothing more than relaxing on the sofa for a snuggle.

Noodle is currently in foster care in Southampton. He is looking for a home that matches both his energy and affectionate side. With structure and companionship, he should settle nicely into family life.

name: Reggie
description:
Reggie is a 10 month old male small Cross-Breed.

Reggie (was Chance) is looking for a new home. Sadly this boy, not quite a year old, finds himself looking for a new home.

This gorgeous boy came to our care in August 2025 in Romania, and the vet didn’t think he’d survive 48 hours. But he proved us all wrong, and we named him Chance, as he was fighting for a second chance!

He was so excited to be adopted in the UK December!

He was renamed Reggie, and has been loving his walks, cuddles and is such a friendly boy. But sadly Reggie and the resident dog did not gel. So he is now on the hunt for another home.

Reggie is 10kg, and medium sized. He is good with people but can be boisterous. A typical teenager, he can be vocal and can try to test boundaries!

Reggie is such a clever boy, and even though he’s only been in the country for a couple of months, he has already nearly completed his Bronze Kennel Club training!

Reggie would be happy as an only dog or living with other medium or large size dogs.

Reggie is in Thatcham, near Reading, Berkshire.

name: Tessa
description:
Tessa is one very special little girl, and I have a feeling someone is going to be incredibly lucky to welcome her into their family.

Tessa is a 5 month old female Cross-Breed who is being fostered in Gloucestershire.

I visit Spain twice a year to work with a rescue charity that Starfish has supported for 15 years. At Starfish, we only put dogs up for adoption that I have met personally and would be happy to welcome into my own home with my dogs, or into one of our experienced foster homes. Tessa is one of those dogs.

Tessa is Cindy’s daughter, and Jake is her brother. Sadly, after their owner died, Tessa, Jake, their mum and their siblings were left to fend for themselves in the countryside, in an empty house.

They were frightened and in poor condition when they were found, but thanks to the wonderful volunteers at the rescue, they have gradually begun to thrive.

Two of the puppies found homes quite quickly, but Tessa and Jake are still waiting. They are growing up in kennels, and it really is time for these lovely youngsters to find families of their own.

I spent time with Tessa during my recent visit to Spain, taking her out for the day with Ferran, and I absolutely fell in love with her. I’m not sure words or videos can quite do justice to what a lovely girl she is!

For a puppy of just five months, Tessa has the most wonderful nature. She has a real old-soul quality about her, taking everything in her stride and behaving like a much older, more experienced dog.

She travelled beautifully in the car and was lovely out walking with Judith, calmly taking in people, other dogs and all the sights and sounds around her. She was equally good when we popped into a shop, just quietly accepting everything that was happening around her.

Of course, she is still a puppy, and she does have one little weakness: food! If anyone was handing out treats, Tessa was definitely there to remind them she was available.

When we stopped at a café, she soon settled down once she realised nobody was going to share their lunch, and promptly fell asleep!

Back at the rescue, I watched her interacting with the other dogs. Like her mum, Cindy, she is quite submissive, with a gentle nature that makes her a pleasure to spend time with. She really is a lovely girl, and I can see so much potential in her.

Tessa is a bright girl who should be a joy to train, particularly as she is so food-motivated. Although she has a mixture of active breeds in her background, I think she will be quite adaptable and enjoy being part of everyday family life, with walks, adventures, playtime and the opportunity to learn.

She loves running over the fields, and I can imagine her having great fun trying activities such as agility when she is old enough. Most importantly, she needs a loving home that will give her the time, guidance and companionship every young dog needs as she grows up.

I genuinely think Tessa is a very special little dog. She has already shown herself to be confident in new situations, gentle with other dogs and wonderfully easy to have around. I would quite happily keep her myself if the right home doesn’t come along!

If you think you could offer Tessa the happy future she deserves, we would love to hear from you.

Tessa is too young to be spayed at present, and her adopter will be required to have this carried out at the appropriate age as part of our adoption agreement. She will be vaccinated, microchipped and have the required blood tests completed.

Tessa has so much love and potential to give. Someone is going to be very lucky indeed to have this gorgeous girl as part of their family.

She was quite keen to taste our food at first

Walking through the shopping centre. She was so good

Out over the fields. Look at her charging back to us

She was not even fazed while Aunty Judith looked at clothes and toys for the dogs

name: Billybob
description:
Meet Billybob, a little boy with so much love to give.

Billybob is an approximately 4 month old male Cross-Breed who will be fostered in Gloucestershire.

I visit Spain twice a year to work alongside a rescue charity that Starfish has proudly supported for 15 years.

At Starfish, we only put dogs up for adoption that I have met personally and would be happy to welcome into my own home with my dogs, or into one of our experienced foster homes.

Billybob is one of those dogs. See the videos at the bottom so you can see why I want to help him find his forever home.

Billybob was found when he was still very tiny, simply discarded and left to fend for himself. Thankfully, someone found him in their garden, and the charity we support had space to take him into their care.

He was far too little to go into a kennel, so he was lucky enough to be given a place in the house with Keiron, who runs the centre.

I have to say, I am genuinely surprised that nobody has shown an interest in this lovely little boy. There have been videos of him playing and enjoying life shared from Spain, but sadly, no enquiries. Having spent time getting to know him myself, I really hope we can change that.

I would hate to return to Spain next April and find him still waiting for his own family.

So, I have taken the time to get to know Billybob, spend time with him and take him out to see a little more of the world. What I have found is a delightful young dog with a lovely nature and so much potential.

We think he will grow to be a medium-sized dog, although, as a cross-breed, we cannot be certain exactly what he is. One thing I can tell you is that he has the most beautiful grey markings against his white coat, which make him rather special!

Billybob came out with us for the day alongside his friend Josh, and he was such a good little boy. He was happy to say hello to people in the charity shop and behaved beautifully when we stopped at a local café.

Of course, all these experiences were new to him, and at times he found it a little overwhelming, but he coped remarkably well. In fact, he felt comfortable enough to fall fast asleep in both the shop and the café! I think that tells you quite a lot about this little fellow.

Back at the centre, Billybob has his own group of doggy friends to play with, and he is used to having people around him. When I returned for a second visit, he was so pleased to see me.

We had some lovely interactions, and I have lots of videos to share below so you can see for yourself what a gorgeous little character he is.

Billybob is very much a blank canvas. He is still a puppy, so he will need all the usual time, patience and commitment that comes with bringing a young dog into your life.

He needs a family who will help him learn about the world, continue his socialisation, attend puppy classes and teach him how to grow into a happy, confident adult. He must not be left for long hours on his own.

Having grown up surrounded by other dogs and with people close by, he will need time to adjust to life in a home of his own.

There will be new experiences to navigate, and he may be unsure of things initially, but I really don’t think he is a particularly complicated little dog. Give him kindness, reassurance and time, and you will see his lovely personality shine through.

I feel he would be happiest in a home with another friendly, well-socialised dog to help show him the ropes. Once Billybob knows you, he absolutely loves you!

He is especially fond of cuddles and loves nothing more than snuggling into your arms like a baby. You will see exactly what I mean in the videos.

What Billybob needs is a family who will love him for the dog he is, enjoy helping him learn and grow, and give him the time and companionship every puppy deserves. In return, I think they will have a very special little friend.

Billybob will not be neutered while he is too young, so we cannot consider a home with any entire dogs. His new family will be required to honour our neutering agreement when he is old enough.

Before travelling to the UK, he will be fully vaccinated, microchipped and have the necessary blood tests completed.

If you have been thinking about adding a puppy to your family and can offer Billybob the time, company and guidance he needs, please get in touch.

Let’s make sure this little boy’s next chapter is the one he has always deserved.

Billybob is waiting for his very own family. Could that be you? Have a look at his videos below.

Walking with his best friend Josh and Cindy

Mixing with the other dogs with Aunty Judith

With Keiron, the kennel manager. Billybob loves him and enjoys his cuddles.

Travelling in the car. He was so relaxed.

name: Josh
description:
Little Josh  – 4-month-old mixed-breed boy, to be fostered in Gloucestershire.

Just look at that face! Josh is seriously cute, but he has a lovely character to match, full of fun, mischief and love.

I visit Spain twice a year to work alongside a rescue charity that Starfish has proudly supported for 15 years. At Starfish, we only put dogs up for adoption that I have met personally and would be happy to welcome into my own home with my dogs, or into one of our experienced foster homes. Josh is one of those very special dogs.

Please watch the videos at the bottom of his profile and you will see exactly why I want to help him find his forever home.

Little Josh is best described as a miniature Labrador! Like so many puppies before him, he was found abandoned when he was tiny.

Thankfully, he was lucky enough to secure a rescue place with the charity we support. Like Billybob, he is currently living in the house with Keiron, the kennel manager, along with his best friend Billybob.

I absolutely loved this little boy. He is a fairly confident, happy puppy who loves playing with all his doggy friends, as you will see in his videos.

We took Josh out for an adventure with Billybob and Cindy, and he was an absolute star. He met people and other dogs beautifully, behaved so well in the café and took everything in his stride.

I honestly couldn’t fault him. There was just nothing not to love about him, and with that ridiculously cute face, he certainly makes you want to scoop him up for a cuddle!

Josh is well socialised with both people and other dogs. His current home is in a fairly remote setting, surrounded by lots of other dogs and lovely volunteers who help care for them and take them out walking.

What he hasn’t had much opportunity to experience yet is everyday life out in the wider world.

As you can see from our videos, he coped brilliantly with his little outing and really enjoyed himself.

His new family will need to continue introducing him gently and positively to all the sights, sounds and experiences of everyday life, helping him grow into a confident, well-rounded adult dog.

We think Josh would be happiest in a home with another friendly dog, or dogs, as this is what he has been used to from such a young age.

He is still a baby, so his new family will need the time and patience to help him learn, explore and develop into the lovely dog we know he can be.

Josh will be fully vaccinated and microchipped, and his blood tests will be completed before travelling to the UK.

If you have the time, love and commitment to offer a young dog, and you’re looking for a little character who will bring plenty of fun and affection into your life, we would love to hear from you.

Please watch Josh’s videos below – we think you’re going to fall in love with him!

Was so good in the Charity Shop just laying their taking it all in

Typical man at the Charity shop had that really bored look at him and his friend Billybob

name: Bambi
description:
Bambi is a small to medium spanielish crossbreed aged around two years old.Bambi fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Bambi has joined us recently from a private shelter in Romania.

Bambi was rescued from a nearby town. It had been a very rainy period and Bambi, along with five other dogs, was begging for food at the entrance to a shop.

Bambi is a sweet and submissive girl who has so much love to give. She is initially wary of people approaching her which indicates she has known abuse in her past.

She gets on very well with the dogs in her foster home but wouldn’t want to live with any that are super boisterous. She could also happily live as the only dog in the home. She could live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

name: Olivia
description:
Olivia is a medium sized dog set on a small dogs legs. She is probably a corgi cross or similar. She was born in March 2025 – making her eighteen months old. Olivia fostered Norwich Norfolk.

“Olivia was found by the side of the road, she had been hit by a car. We actually went to that village searching for a mum with pups and Olivia was lying down, wagging her tail.

At the beggining she appeared just to be resting but then we noticed she did not get up. Probably she had just been hit. She had an open humerus fracture, the bone was completely broken in two.

Despite this she did not bite when we lifted her up into the car. She has a very sweet optimistic temperament.”

Olivia is now in the UK and is a little sweetheart. She has a pin in her previously damaged leg which will remain in for the rest of her life. She should require no further treatment but may get arthritis in later life…. as do we all lol.

Olivia is mixing very nicely with the other dogs in her foster home but could live very happily as the only dog in the home. She could live with respectful children aged four plus. She is a calm and gentle girl who loves people.

name: Jemma
description:
Jemma is a medium sized crossbreed aged a year old. Jemma fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Jemma has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She is a sweet, affectionate and playful girl who will simply need a bit of basic training and new experiences.

She mixes well with the other dogs in her foster home but could also be the only dog in her forever home.

She could live with respectful children aged six plus.
